blocks.text: Data enrichment and automated research for sales prospecting

Clay functions as the research and enrichment layer of a modern sales stack. Instead of manually researching each prospect, Clay waterfall-enriches your leads across 100+ data providers - pulling company size, funding stage, tech stack, hiring patterns, and contact information automatically.

The AI research agent can perform custom research tasks: find a company's latest product launch, summarize their recent blog posts, or identify their biggest competitor. This automated research powers personalized outreach that sounds hand-crafted but scales to thousands of prospects.

Clay's table-based interface makes complex enrichment workflows accessible. Each row is a prospect, each column is a data point, and you build enrichment pipelines by adding columns. Non-technical sales ops teams can create sophisticated data workflows without coding.
Waterfall enrichment across Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and more
Custom AI research tasks for each prospect automatically
Spreadsheet-like UI for building enrichment workflows
Generate personalized outreach using enriched prospect data
Push enriched data to HubSpot, Salesforce, and Outreach
Trigger enrichment from any source with webhooks and API

Clay transforms prospecting from manual research into automated enrichment. For teams doing personalized outbound at scale, the time savings from automated research and AI personalization are massive.
Our team can integrate Clay into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
